violation_type.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §744.3553(5))
violation_type.typical_finding: The emergency preparedness plan did not include how the operation will reunify the children with their parents as the evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted.

finding_variants.text: The emergency preparedness plan did not include how the operation will reunify the children with their parents as the evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted.
